cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess

text = '''# Compile requirements.txt files from all found or specified requirements.in files (compile).
# Use -h to include hashes, -u dep1,dep2... to upgrade specific dependencies, and -U to upgrade all.
pipc () {  # [-h] [-U|-u <pkgspec>[,<pkgspec>...]] [<reqs-in>...] [-- <pip-compile-arg>...]
    emulate -L zsh
    unset REPLY
    if [[ $1 == --help ]] { zpy $0; return }
    [[ $ZPY_PROCS ]] || return

    local gen_hashes upgrade upgrade_csv
    while [[ $1 == -[hUu] ]] {
        if [[ $1 == -h ]] { gen_hashes=--generate-hashes; shift   }
        if [[ $1 == -U ]] { upgrade=1;                    shift   }
        if [[ $1 == -u ]] { upgrade=1; upgrade_csv=$2;    shift 2 }
    }
}
'''
pattern = r'^(?P<predoc>\n?(# .*\n)*)(alias (?P<aname>pipc)="[^"]+"|(?P<fname>pipc) \(\) \{)(  #(?P<usage> .+))?'
expected = ' [-h] [-U|-u <pkgspec>[,<pkgspec>...]] [<reqs-in>...] [-- <pip-compile-arg>...]\n'
for engine in ['default', 'pcre2']:
    args = ['target/debug/rg', '--no-config', '--color', 'never', '-NU', '--engine', engine]
    plain = subprocess.run(args + [pattern], input=text, text=True, capture_output=True, check=True)
    assert plain.stdout == ''.join(text.splitlines(keepends=True)[:3]), repr(plain.stdout)
    replaced = subprocess.run(args + ['-r', '$usage', pattern], input=text, text=True, capture_output=True, check=True)
    assert replaced.stdout == expected, repr(replaced.stdout)
print('Original reproduction produces exactly the expected output with both regex engines.')
PY
